verdict.rationale: Secureframe offers several AI-generated insight features embedded in the product: Comply AI for Risk (auto-generated risk scores/treatments/justifications), Comply AI for Policies (AI-drafted/revised policy text), Comply AI for vendor risk (auto-extracting answers from vendor security docs), and AI-generated SSPs/POA&Ms/SPRS scores reflecting live compliance data. These are genuine 'AI-generated insights from your data' within specific workflows rather than a general-purpose AI insights layer across all product data. Missing for 10: evidence of a unified/cross-module AI insights or chat interface surfacing suggestions across all data, and independent/hands-on validation of these AI features' accuracy or usefulness.
